headword: {中途採用|ちゅうとさいよう}

definitions.explanation: Hiring someone who has prior work experience, as opposed to recruiting fresh graduates ({新卒採用|しんそつさいよう}). A significant concept in Japanese employment culture, where the traditional model emphasizes hiring new graduates.

examples.japanese: {中途採用|ちゅうとさいよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}した→入社する：25409_nyuushasuru⟧。
examples.english: I joined the company as a mid-career hire.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{中途採用|ちゅうとさいよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: This company actively hires mid-career professionals.

examples.japanese: {中途採用|ちゅうとさいよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{即戦力|そくせんりょく}→即戦力：17917_sokusenryoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In mid-career hiring, companies often look for people who can contribute immediately.

notes:
USAGE:
{中途採用|ちゅうとさいよう} is contrasted with ⟦{新卒採用|しんそつさいよう}→新卒採用：29208_shinsotsusaiyou⟧ (hiring of new graduates), which has traditionally been the dominant hiring model in Japan. As the labor market evolves, {中途採用|ちゅうとさいよう} has become increasingly common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中途採用|ちゅうとさいよう}{枠|わく} (mid-career hiring slot)
- {中途採用|ちゅうとさいよう}⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧ (mid-career interview)
- {中途採用|ちゅうとさいよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}する→入社する：25409_nyuushasuru⟧ (to join via mid-career hiring)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditionally, Japanese companies hired almost exclusively from new graduates ({新卒一括採用|しんそついっかつさいよう}). {中途採用|ちゅうとさいよう} was once seen as less prestigious, but this perception has changed significantly.
